name: Conword
description: Provides integration for the Conword content/translation service.
project_description:
This module provides product integrations for the DeepL based translation tool from Conword GmbH 

 Features 
 
 conword integration 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Go to /admin/config/services/conword to configure your valid customer ID and set up your individual display settings.

 Additional Requirements 
 To get a customer ID, wich is required to run the conword integration, you need a valid contract with Conword GmbH
